label: Diagram 4
caption: Diagram 4 Requirement RA1 – a. schematic example of gigabit-ready physical infrastructure from the network termination point to the access point in an individual dwelling, and b. schematic example of gigabit-ready physical infrastructure from the network termination points in dwellings in a building containing more than one dwelling, in this case containing multiple dwellings, to the common access point in or on the building
description:
The drawing is a two-part schematic, labelled a. and b., set within simple line outlines of buildings.

Part a. shows a single dwelling with a pitched roof and two storeys. Near the base, a green rectangle is labelled "Network termination point" and is joined by a short horizontal line to a second green rectangle on the right, labelled "Access point".

Part b. shows a taller building with a pitched roof and five storeys. A vertical line runs down the central column, labelled "Ducting/ trays in riser". On the upper four storeys, pairs of green rectangles sit on either side of this line and are linked to it by short horizontal lines; the left-hand rectangle on the third storey is labelled "Network termination point in each dwelling". At the base, the vertical riser line terminates in a single green rectangle to the left of the line, labelled "Common access point". A caption strip at the bottom reads "Diagram 4" and restates the requirement RA1 wording.
